# codex-worker

Guides a Claude Code session that hands a code change to a Codex CLI run. Covers the sandbox scope, the background run, monitoring, follow-ups, and an independent review. Do not use it when the agent itself runs inside Codex.

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`codex-worker`](skills/codex-worker/README.md) | Delegates a code change from a Claude Code session to an outside Codex CLI worker. Covers sandbox scope, the `codex exec` run, monitoring, follow-ups, review, and a worker inside the pstack Orchestrate playbook. Use when Claude Code is the harness and a code delegate should be a Codex CLI run, or when asked to hand a task to Codex, run `codex exec`, or use Codex as a worker or reviewer. Do not use when the agent itself runs inside Codex. |

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
/plugin install codex-worker@Uraxii
```

For other harnesses, see the [repository README](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai#install).
